implemented_requirements.evidence: SudokuBoard.__init__ creates self.grid as a 9x9 list of lists; generation loops over 81 cells.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Each row, column, and 3x3 subgrid must contain digits 1-9 exactly once
implemented_requirements.evidence: SudokuBoard._is_rule_valid checks row, column, and box for duplicates; SudokuBoard.is_complete verifies that every row, column and box equals the set {1..9}.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Allow player to input values for specific cells
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py parses commands "row col value" and calls board.place(r-1, c-1, v) to set a cell.
The "check" command invokes report_mistakes which uses board.conflicts() and board.wrong_vs_solution() to report rule violations and mismatches with the solution.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Confirm when the puzzle is completed
implemented_requirements.evidence: After each move main.py calls board.is_complete(); if true it prints a congratulatory message.

judge.summary: The provided code implements a fully functional 9x9 Sudoku game with generation, user input, mistake checking, and completion detection. All core requirements are satisfied and the code appears ready to run as a command‑line program.
